profile.headline: Software Engineer at Reddit
profile.summary: Experienced full stack software engineer with a demonstrated history of building exceptional products. Skilled in JavaScript, React, Typescript, Node.js, MongoDB, and SQL. Based in Portland.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: LitElement · GraphQL · TypeScript · Matrix Communication Protocol · Software Lifecycle Management · Team Building

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description: Moved out of state, traveled, helped with family matters, studied various programming-related skills, planned for future business endeavors, and spent time in reflection.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented new analytics eventing system to track conversions against business updates and experiments
Increased lead quality by 17% to its all-time high and reduced marketing spend on qualified leads by 7% by automating target audience and offline conversion refinement
Organized, maintained, and documented marketing integrations from various sources (Heap, Google Ads, GTM, Facebook)
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · React.js · Martech · MySQL

positions.title: Full Stack Web/Mobile Developer
positions.description:
Led development of a design-heavy internal app integrated with a headless CMS for easy use by non-technical team members
Rewrote a major feature of the agency's most-used application from AngularJS to React.
Led effort to secure personal data in the agency’s sports client management application in compliance with GDPR.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed, code reviewed, led an eclectic range of projects. Met strict deadlines, adapted efficiently based on client feedback, produced high quality web applications.
Researched & led development of the company’s first React application.
Outlined schema architecture, API paths, application structure, and created documentation as team lead for a consumer product catalog project.
Improved adherence of a telemedicine app to HIPAA security requirements by 70%.

positions.title: Healthcare Online and Enterprise Services Intern
positions.description:
Improved usability of public website with UX/UI team.
Worked with business systems analysts to better integration of  technology into workflow for patients and providers.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Supported instructors by providing lectures and live demos.
Educated students on programming concepts and algorithms.

positions.title: Certified Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
Accurately and efficiently assisted the pharmacist in preparing prescription orders.
Provided quality customer service to patients and other healthcare providers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Performed behavior testing on mice(novel object recognition, object in place, temporal order).
Produced brain sections using cryostat.
Collected images of sections using confocal microscope.
Virtually reconstructed and analyzed neurons using XuvStitch, AutoQuantX, and Imaris.
Immunostained tissues.

company.name: UC Irvine Department of Radiation Oncology - Limoli Lab

honors.title: UROP Fellow
honors.description: Received appointment as a UROP (Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program) Fellow for the 2014-2015 school year. I was awarded a grant for my project, "Effects of Titanium Particle Radiation on Medial Prefrontal Cortex of the Mouse Brain," and presented my findings at the 2015 UCI Undergraduate Research Symposium.
honors.issuer: Issued by UC Irvine Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program · Jan 2015
